_comment: OIDC Core (OIDCC) certification test-plan matrix consumed by conformance/scripts/run-oidcc-suite.sh. The complementary FAPI 2.0 and mTLS plans live in conformance/plan-*.json and are driven by scripts/oidc-conformance.sh; this file is dedicated to the OpenID Connect Core certification plans defined by the OpenID Foundation conformance suite (https://gitlab.com/openid/conformance-suite). Each entry names a published plan id from https://openid.net/certification/ and pins the variant matrix that maps to coauth's static client registration. Adding a new plan: append an entry, then re-run conformance/scripts/run-oidcc-suite.sh --list to verify the runner picks it up.

plans.description: OpenID Connect Core 1.0 Basic OP certification profile: response_type=code, client_secret_basic auth, discovery + dynamic registration + userinfo + id_token + RP-initiated logout.
OpenID Connect Core 1.0 Hybrid OP certification profile: response_type=code id_token / code token / code id_token token, nonce + at_hash + c_hash verification, fragment response_mode.

OpenID Connect Device Authorization (RFC 8628 + OIDC binding) certification profile: device_authorization_endpoint, slow_down / authorization_pending polling semantics, expires_in + interval enforcement.
